name: VoxCPM2 (OpenBMB)
usage: Speech synthesis: voice design from a description, cloning, 30 languages

formats.value: official: safetensors + audiovae.pth + .py tokenizer; mlx-community bf16: safetensors only

languages.value: 30 languages including French and German (card tags)

runtimes.value: mlx-audio (native voxcpm2 model; loader fixed in issues #649 and #736); official voxcpm package (CUDA, MPS)

provenance.value: strong for the language model: 2,290,004,544 bf16 parameters, the exact count of the official model.safetensors; the 93.8 M fp32 parameters of the audio VAE come from the official audiovae.pth (no safetensors upstream)
provenance.note: uploaded 08.04.2026 by the author of mlx-audio PR #641 (VoxCPM2 support, merged 30.04.2026); base_model openbmb/VoxCPM2; 3,557 downloads, no discussion

web.scope: Released 03.04.2026: comments since 15.05.2026 plus the launch discussions. Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, VoxCPM and mlx-audio issues. Reddit unreadable (HTTP 403). **Feedback moderate to thin**; no independent French data.
web.summary: Quality called very good; in one small independent German test, fewer word errors than Qwen3-TTS and Chatterbox Multilingual; cloned speech sometimes too fast; early MPS noise on M5 fixed.
web.verdict: Best German WER in one small test; voice design; M5 MPS bug fixed

comments.text: Third-party benchmark on 10 FLEURS pairs per language: German word error rate 3.8 % against 10.8 % for Qwen3-TTS Base and 5.2 % for Chatterbox Multilingual; speaker similarity 0.73 against 0.78 for Chatterbox ([HF #17, 02.07.2026](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/VoxCPM2/discussions/17), [soniqo.audio](https://www.soniqo.audio/blog/voice-cloning-benchmarks)).

Quality called incredibly good, but cloned speech sometimes comes out two to three times too fast; changing the seed helped ([HF #3, 08.04–14.09.2026](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/VoxCPM2/discussions/3)).
Cross-lingual cloning keeps an accent; naming the target language in the control instruction largely removes it ([HF #14, 14.05.2026](https://huggingface.co/openbmb/VoxCPM2/discussions/14)).

Noise on an M5 Mac with MPS in bf16, fixed in a later version ([VoxCPM #301, 10–19.05.2026](https://github.com/OpenBMB/VoxCPM/issues/301)); a LoRA voice adapter trained on it for an assistant ([HN, 09.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49623246)).
